thread:
incident-bot: Pager - SEV2: Quality regression detected for tenant "Kestrel Health" on dedicated pool dp-17. Signal: eval F1 down ~14% vs baseline for model gptx-13b@quant-v2. Triggered 2026-03-15T01:02Z. Paging oncall @sam.

sam: Ack, taking it. @jordan can you confirm whether a quantization profile change was promoted recently for that tenant/pool? Link to the runbook: /runbooks/model-regression.

jordan: I see an automated promotion event ~2054319990 that promoted quant-v2 for gptx-13b scoped to tenant Kestrel in dp-17. Eval harness shows increased token-level softmax entropy and several hallucination cases. Pulling diffs and sample transcripts now.

maya: Observing user-reported quality drop in Kestrel transcripts. No increased 5xxs or infra errors. Important: other tenants on dp-17 look fine — this is tenant-scoped.

sam: Good, isolation confirmed. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback quant profile for Kestrel to quant-v1 2) block automatic promotions for dp-17 3) if rollback not possible quickly, route Kestrel to fallback variant. lucas can you do tenant-scoped rollback?

lucas: We have tenant override APIs. Running tenant-scoped rollback now:
```
redwoodctl tenant-config set kestrel model.gptx-13b.quant_profile=quant-v1 --pool dp-17
```
Executing command.

deploy-bot: Action started: tenant-config update job id jc-8821 for tenant kestrel by lucas. ETA ~30s.

jordan: Also going to disable the quant-v2 promotion pipeline for dp-17 until RCA. I'll patch the CI rule and stop the promo job.

sam: Alice — please notify the customer briefly: acknowledge degradation, say we're rolling back a model config and expect restoration in 10-30m. Reassure about data safety.

alice: Notified Kestrel Health on their escalation channel: "We detected a regression from a quantization change and are rolling back to the prior profile. Responses should normalize shortly; we'll follow up with an RCA. No data exposure." They acknowledged and asked if PHI was affected; I confirmed no. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: job jc-8821 completed successfully. New tenant config applied: quant_profile=quant-v1 for kestrel on dp-17.

sam: Confirm with QA/eval harness and keep monitor running. Jordan, can you run a quick eval on the customer's prompt set?

jordan: Running quick eval now against the customer's golden prompts... summary: pre-rollback F1=0.68, post-rollback preliminary F1=0.86. Sample responses look back in line. Will continue watching for 10m.

maya: I'll keep a monitoring shard focused on this tenant. Temporarily adjusting alert thresholds to avoid noisy flapping but keeping circuit breaker active if latency or error rate spikes.

lucas: Also updated routing to favor the fallback variant to be safe:
```
redwoodctl routing set kestrel preference=[gptx-13b@quant-v1,gptx-13b@fp16] --pool dp-17
```

sam: Oncall handoff in ~20m to zoe. If stable, close after 60m of post-rollback observation. Who volunteers for postmortem? jordan for model-side RCA, lucas for infra/deploy guardrail follow-up, maya for monitoring changes, alice will draft customer-facing post-incident note.

zoe: Taking handoff. @sam DM logs and the eval output when you have them. I'll monitor overnight.

jordan: Quick note for RCA: initial hypothesis — quant-v2's recalibration interacts poorly with Kestrel's prompt-length distribution and prefix caching, causing token probability shifts for mid-sequence tokens. Plan: add per-tenant validation, canary window, and a stricter rollback gate to the promotion pipeline. Opening PR now.

sam: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread updated. Target: close incident if metrics stable for 60m after rollback. :white_check_mark:
